page_title: BOU 1-1 WHU | Bournemouth v West Ham 16/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+8' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Lukasz Fabianski makes a great save to stop his effort.
90+7' Max Kilman (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kepa Arrizabalaga, who smothers the ball.
90+7' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
90+6' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by David Brooks (Bournemouth), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
90+5' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but Lukasz Fabianski punches the ball away.
90+5' That's the end of the game for Aaron Wan-Bissaka, who is replaced by Kaelan Casey (West Ham).
90+5' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) brings an opponent down and Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
90+3' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+2' The resulting corner from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) comes to nothing.
90+2' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 1 Enes Unal (Bournemouth) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. He bends the ball into the top left corner. A technically stunning goal.
89' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
87' 0 - 1 Goal! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kepa Arrizabalaga to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
86' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is going to take the penalty!
85' It’s a PENALTY to West Ham after the VAR review!
84' There's a break in play and referee Chris Kavanagh must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by West Ham using VAR. This could be interesting!
84' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

83' What a save from Kepa Arrizabalaga! Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
81' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
81' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Fabianski gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
81' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
80' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Evanilson is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Justin Kluivert walks off the pitch to be replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
79' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) collects a pass and has an effort from 25 metres out, but it flies just over the crossbar.
77' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
76' PENALTY APPEAL after Evanilson (Bournemouth) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
75' Julen Lopetegui has decided to substitute Edson Alvarez and he is replaced by Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
75' The referee signals a substitution. Oliver Scarles (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Mohammed Kudus.
73' The corner from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.
73' Evanilson (Bournemouth) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the top right corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
73' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) prepares to take a corner kick.
73' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

72' Mohammed Kudus almost found himself in a promising position after Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
71' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Evanilson (Bournemouth) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
71' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
70' The corner is floated into the centre of the box, but a placed header from Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) flies well wide of the right post.
70' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
69' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. Now West Ham have a corner.
68' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) replaces Adam Smith.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Antoine Semenyo as he is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
67' The foul by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
67' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

67' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
63' Julen Lopetegui is stunned as referee Chris Kavanagh shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
62' What was Edson Alvarez (West Ham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
62' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

61' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
60' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort that ends well wide of the right post.
57' Ryan Christie delivers a perfect cross for Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
56' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
56' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) is coming onto the pitch as Carlos Soler cannot continue after picking up an injury.
56' A pass lands at the feet of Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
54' A precise low pass is received by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
51' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
50' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

50' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Lukasz Fabianski was alert and the score remains the same. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
48' A great solo run by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Lukasz Fabianski.

47' A neat pass is well received by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
47' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

45' Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
45' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
42' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
42' A lofted pass into the box is met by Tomas Soucek (West Ham), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.

38' West Ham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
35' 6:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
29' Carlos Soler (West Ham) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
28' Evanilson (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

26' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Kepa Arrizabalaga pulls off a brilliant save.
24' Carlos Soler (West Ham) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
23' Carlos Soler (West Ham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

21' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Evanilson was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
20' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga reads it well and gathers the ball.
19' A cross from Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
17' West Ham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
16' OFF THE POST! Good play from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes against the crossbar!
15' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
14' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.
14' Max Kilman (West Ham) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. West Ham have a corner.
14' The referee awards a corner and Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) goes over to take it.

12' OFF THE POST! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
11' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman signals a throw-in for West Ham.
10' Chris Kavanagh blows the whistle, Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) is penalised for a foul.

8' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
7' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

7' This shall not pass! Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
4' A mistake by a defender gifts Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
2' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
